title: Review Step
summary: Lists every answer of a multi-step form by step with Edit links before submit, flagging empty, missing and changed answers.
description: Review page for wizards: every answer by step with named Edit links, empty optional fields and values changed since last time flagged, missing required answers blocking submit, and one deliberate submit that ignores carried-over clicks and disables while pending.
catches: Empty optional fields, shown as "Not provided"
Values changed since the previous submission
A click carried over from the previous step's button (guard window)
Repeat clicks while the submit is pending
limits: Display formatting is yours (pass format for money or masking)
a11y: Each step is a section labelled by its title
Edit/Add buttons have aria-labels naming the step or field
Submit is described by the missing-answers note; errors use role=alert
Changed values have a sr-only "Previously:" prefix
server: Validate every answer again and make the final submit idempotent on the server.
stops: Wrong answer submitted in a wizard
